A metal bracket snaps under the weight and a pendant light is knocked loose and shatters on the tiles.

title: Scene 6 — 2s: Edible Resolution

The vines curl into a wreath around the monster's shoulders and spread across the checkout counter. Shoppers tentatively taste the vines and visibly relax. Overhead the Kaufhaus PA crackles and an old BRD store jingle plays as the store logo flickers.
